title: MLS named LAFC co-owner Larry Berg as its next commissioner. Here's what to know
description: For their commissioner of the future, MLS owners chose a soccer native. Berg's team is seen as one of MLS's best-run franchises, and he has embraced rule changes designed to modernize the league.

title: China’s Nonsmokers Try to Clear the Air, One Confrontation at a Time
description: Disputes between smokers and nonsmokers are becoming more visible as a younger generation increasingly refuses to suffer secondhand smoke in silence.

title: 2026 Midterms State of Play: Key races unfold as Stevens, El-Sayed battle in Michigan
description: Rep. Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed battle in Michigan's Democratic senate primary as progressive and establishment wings clash over party direction.

title: Lindsay Clancy strikes evidence deal as fingerprint gap opens trial debate, expert says
description: Lindsay Clancy agreed to a stipulation in court as a state police trooper testified no usable fingerprints were found on a knife or exercise bands.

title: Yankees bullpen rebounds in big way after rough first game following deadline
description: Every game after a trade deadline in which the Yankees did not add to their bullpen (and in fact subtracted) can feel like a referendum on Brian Cashman’s Aug. 3 decision-making.

title: Beloved LA TV anchors resurface after savage firings as new details emerge about their final days on air
